chrome_hint: eBay AU sold listings: '15ct gold gents signet ring green stone', '15ct gold gents ring' and 'antique gents 15ct gold ring green' (Sold items filter), plus Terapeak for the same. Check Leski, Leonard Joel, Mossgreen and Theodore Bruce results for 'gents 15ct signet ring' and 'gents gold ring green spinel'. Price by weight: record grams for each comp (15ct is about 62.5% gold).
viewing_check: Ask staff to weigh the ring in grams (decides the gold value). Look inside the shank for any 15ct, 375, 750 or maker mark and check for a gold-test scratch. Check whether the stone is glass or spinel (back of the setting, closed or open back) and that the shank is solid, not hollow or filled.
